pieces.Text: When you have had at least a number of drinks equal to your Constitution modifier (or get drunk or soused, if you are using the rules on pages 54-55) in a tavern, once within the following 24 hours, you can gain the benefits of remove paralysis as a free action. Alternatively, you can choose one of the following benefits depending on the type of bar you patronized. At the GM's discretion, other types of taverns might grant other benefits. [Gambling Den] You can gain the benefits of detect thoughts for 1 minute as a free action. [Illegal Tavern] You can gain the benefits of invisibility for 1 minute as a free action. [Posh Tavern] You can gain the benefits of eagle's splendor for 1 minute as a free action. [Private Club] You can gain the benefits of undetectable alignment for 1 minute as a free action. [Rowdy Bar] You can gain the benefits of bear's endurance for 1 minute as a free action. [Tavern of Intrigue] You can gain the benefits of fox's cunning for 1 minute as a free action.
